capabilities: Pull Docmost page trees into one subfolder per space as Markdown notes
Push new and edited notes back to Docmost as pages
Download and upload images and attachments into per-space attachment folders
Detect conflicts and save the local version as a conflict copy
Sync on startup, on an interval, after editing or manually
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.11.4+ and a recent Docmost (Markdown content API, tested with v0.97.0); not yet tested on iOS or iPadOS. API key login needs a paid Docmost Enterprise license, while email and password work with the free Community edition; accounts with MFA or enforced SSO cannot log in that way. Credentials are kept in Obsidian's secret storage, and the plugin talks only to the server URL you enter.
problem: Docmost pages and Obsidian notes live apart, so content, images and attachments have to be copied between them by hand.

relations.evidence: Two-way sync between Docmost spaces and a folder in your Obsidian vault

summary: Two-way sync between Docmost spaces and a vault folder, pulling pages down as Markdown notes and pushing edits, images and attachments back.
